message: Are you seriously trying to pass off your own lack of qualifications as a virtue? Newsflash: being an expert doesn't just mean being a Twitter troll with a bad haircut, it means putting in actual work, reading actual studies, and understanding actual policy. And yet, here you are, making sweeping generalizations about my position based on a 10-second glance at a Wikipedia page. Your "regulated market" is just a euphemism for "I want to control the narrative and dictate what people can and can't do." You're not a free thinker, you're a script-reader, reciting the same tired lines you've been fed by the echo chamber. And as for your precious "little guy," don't make me laugh – you're not fighting for them, you're fighting for your own ego. So go ahead, keep spewing this drivel, but I'm not going to waste my breath on someone who can't even be bothered to do their homework.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'a script-reader' and 'someone who can't even be bothered to do their homework', directly attacking their intelligence and effort.  Also uses 'drivel' to dismiss their argument.
